title: Booklet allocation exceeds PHP memory limit
root_cause: The process has a 32 MiB PHP memory limit but requests a 48 MiB string buffer. PHP terminates the render when the allocation exceeds that limit.

relevant_evidence.why: PHP reports that its allowed memory was exhausted.
The command sets a 32 MiB memory limit.
The program requests a 48 MiB string.
